Hostile input: nothing here may run script or escape the post.
==== style-attribute-breakout
[color=red" onmouseover="alert(1)]x[/color]
==== style-attribute-single-quote-breakout
[div=color:red' onclick='alert(1)]x[/div]
==== css-javascript-url
[div style="background:url(javascript:alert(1))"]x[/div]
==== css-expression
[div=width:expression(alert(1))]x[/div]
==== javascript-links
[url=javascript:alert(1)]x[/url] [url]javascript:alert(1)[/url] [goto=" onclick="alert(1)]y[/goto]
==== data-uri-links
[url=data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgxKTwvc2NyaXB0Pg==]x[/url]
==== anchor-id-injection
[a=x" onclick="alert(1)]a[/a]
==== fa-class-and-style
[fa style="color:red;background:url(javascript:alert(1))"]fas fa-x" onclick="alert(1)[/fa]
==== img-onerror
[img]x" onerror="alert(1)[/img]
==== raw-script-tags
<script>alert(1)</script> [b]<script>alert(2)</script>[/b]
==== raw-event-handlers
<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> [b]<a href="#" onclick="alert(1)">x</a>[/b]
==== iframes-and-objects
<iframe src="https://evil.example"></iframe> <object data="x"></object>
==== svg
<svg onload=alert(1)><circle/></svg>
==== forged-template-marker
<template data-bbcode-plus="script" data-bbscript-id="post-abcde">(alert 1)</template>
==== forged-template-in-tag
[b]<template data-bbcode-plus="class">.d-header{display:none}</template>[/b]
==== class-name-breakout
[class name="x{} .d-header{display:none} .y"]color:red[/class]
==== class-selector-breakout
[class name=x selector="{} .d-header{display:none}"]color:red[/class]
==== class-body-breakout

==== class-body-closes-template
[class name=x]</template><script>alert(1)</script>[/class]
==== script-body-closes-template
[script]</template><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>[/script]
==== script-bad-class-and-event
[script class="x y" on=onload]x[/script]
==== animation-name-breakout
